work.composition: horizontal scatter across wide ivory ground
work.description: Panoramic mixed-media collage on ivory ground featuring scattered gold compact discs, a frontal warplane silhouette drawn in ink, and sequined fabric fragments in magenta and blue. Stick figures, crown motifs, and dotted arcs are distributed across the horizontal composition alongside iridescent collaged elements.
work.title: Untitled (CDs and Warplane)
